metadata.title: SpaceX IPO: The stock closes 19% above its IPO price. SpaceX is now the 6th most valuable company on earth. - MarketWatch

content.text:
CONCLUDED
SpaceX IPO: The stock closes 19% above its IPO price. SpaceX is now the 6th most valuable company on earth.
After a record-breaking SpaceX IPO, the stock opened for trading at $150, traded as high $176.52, but closed its first day up 19.2% at $160.95 That's made Elon Musk a trillionaire, as his space-technology company has become the sixth largest company in the world with a market value of more than $2 trillion.
Last Updated:
June 12, 2026 at 6:30 PM ET
Key Events
Pinned Post
Now that SpaceX's stock is officially trading, it's possible to calculate how much it's adding to Elon Musk's net worth.
He owns 6.42 billion SpaceX shares, including 849.5 million of the Class A shares that just started trading. With the stock trading at $172.15, the value of his shares has increased by $238.45 billion since the $135 pricing of the IPO was announced less than 24 hours ago.
He also owns 717.1 million Tesla shares, according to an April ownership filing, and those are up 0.3% on Friday, to add $745.8 million to his wealth.
All that means Musk is $239.2 billion richer today than he was yesterday. Add that to his net worth of $971 billion as of June 11, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, and Musk would be the first trillion-dollar man.
